== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 24 January 2023. The Facebook photo viewer names Paul Willworth. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 99 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Salem, Or; Decipher listing Monmouth, Or). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/ioscode and lists work at Portland General Electric in Oregon.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Paul Willworth portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Paul Willworth Facebook portrait.jpg]].
